# NUXA — Tu Psicólogo IA disponible 24/7

NUXA is a Spanish-language AI mental health platform providing confidential emotional support,
psychological assistance, and wellness resources for individuals, families, and organisations.
Compliant with ISO 45003 (psychosocial risk management) and GDPR. Operating at https://nuxa.life.

Supported languages: Spanish (es), Catalan (ca), Basque (eu), Galician (gl), English (en),
French (fr), German (de), Italian (it), Portuguese (pt).

## Product

NUXA is an AI-powered psychologist available 24/7 — no waiting lists, no appointments, fully
confidential. It provides emotional support, stress management, and mental wellness guidance.
Plans start at €2.99/month; 3 free consultations available with no registration required.
